candidates.notes: Fine-tuned on 25.6k Hinglish social-media posts; lacks pure English and Devanagari training data.
Fine-tuned on Saravia et al. English emotion dataset (6 labels). Has no neutral class.
Fine-tuned on utkarsharora100/google_go_emotions_hindi_translated for Devanagari Hindi (7 labels).
Fine-tuned on Google GoEmotions (58k Reddit comments, 28 labels). Multi-label sigmoid head.

english_candidate_comparison.conversion_disclosure: GoEmotions uses independent BCE logits. Probabilities are computed via torch.sigmoid(logits). Primary displayed emotion is argmax(sigmoid(logits)). All 28 raw scores and thresholded active labels (>=0.5) are preserved.
